methods.name: Stage-Progression
methods.rationale: Applies typical Series B → next-stage step-up multiplier (1.9x) to $20M total raised proxy.

data.narrative:
Amperon is a Series B infrastructure & logistics company founded by Sean Kelly that has raised $20M to date. The valuation analysis proceeds from a single applicable method given the absence of direct public or private comparables in the dataset.

The stage-progression method provides the primary valuation signal. Using total capital raised ($20M) as a proxy for current value and applying a typical Series B-to-next-stage step-up multiplier of 1.9x yields an implied valuation of $38M. This methodology reflects historical patterns in frontier-tech funding rounds within the infrastructure sector, where downstream capital infusions have historically validated or exceeded prior-round pricing by roughly this magnitude.

The triangulated valuation range is $32M (low) to $44M (median $38M). The $12M spread reflects methodological limitations: with only one quantitative approach available and no public or private comparable set to cross-validate, the range incorporates assumed variance around the 1.9x multiplier rather than independent method triangulation. Material uncertainties include unit economics verification, customer concentration, and whether Amperon's specific infrastructure sub-vertical commands pricing at, above, or below sector norms. A fuller analysis would require private comparable data or margin profile alignment to narrow the band materially.
